subject: Post-call: Procurement checklist & next steps for Acme Health
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir.desai@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up and procurement path questions after demo

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — the team appreciated the latency/cost breakdown you showed. A couple of quick items from our side as we work through procurement:

- We need a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that maps Redwood deliverables to our legal/security/finance gates.
- Preference on contract flow: our default is PO (finance issues PO), but we have a small pilot team that can use corporate card if it simplifies lead time.
- Security wants a short QnA and an evidence stub for SOC2/retention policy.

Can you send a post-call checklist and an initial timeline (legal -> security review -> finance -> PO issuance)? Also, do you have a marketplace offering (AWS/GCP marketplace) we can opt into to accelerate purchase?

Best,
Lydia
Procurement Manager | Acme Health
L: 415-555-0198

---
Acme Health (external)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up and procurement path questions after demo

Hi Lydia — great meeting, thanks for the clarity. Per your asks, attached are three artifacts: a one-page mutual action plan template (redwood-mpa-template.xlsx), our security QnA (security-qna.pdf), and a short doc that outlines acceptance of PO vs card and marketplace pathways (po-acceptance-options.pdf).

High-level summary and suggested timeline:
1) Legal review (non-negotiated SOW + standard T&Cs): 5–10 business days once we receive the SOW details.
2) Security review (info sec QnA + evidence): 3–7 business days; we can provide SOC2 report stub + architecture diagram.
3) Finance / procurement decision (PO issuance or card): 2–5 business days after legal + security signoff.
4) Provisioning & kickoff: 1–3 business days after PO/charge.

Suggested immediate next steps (mutual action plan):
- You: share the internal SOW owner and preferred billing instrument (PO vs card) by Thu 3/4.
- Us: we will populate the MPA with milestones, owners, and dates and share a tracked-copy by Wed 3/3.
- Security: Ben will provide the SOC2 stub and an architecture slide.

If you prefer marketplace procurement, we support AWS Marketplace (shelf listing) which can shorten approval for some customers — note that marketplace sales often require a subscription and have different invoicing terms. I included that as an option in po-acceptance-options.pdf.

Attaching the artifacts now. Let us know a good time for a short (15 min) MAP walk-through this week.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: 650-555-0123

Attachments:
- redwood-mpa-template.xlsx (Excel; MAP checklist + owners)
- security-qna.pdf (PDF; 2pp QnA & evidence list)
- po-acceptance-options.pdf (PDF; PO vs card vs marketplace comparison)

---
Internal note: Ben/Marissa looped for SOC2 evidence and commercial terms alignment.

To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up and procurement path questions after demo

Irene / Marissa,

I can own SOC2 stub + architecture slide. I'll drop the artifacts into the shared Drive link and call out the evidence items Acme will likely ask for. Also, quick commercial note: if Lydia's team wants the pilot on a card to start within 48–72h, we can do a short pilot agreement with a capped spend and convert to PO for full rollout. That usually eases finance concerns.

Proposed owners for MPA:
- Legal review owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole (contracts)
- Security evidence owner (Redwood): Ben Carter
- Billing & invoicing contact (Redwood): Irene Choi

I'll update the MPA and mark an internal due date to get the SOC2 artifacts in by 3/3 EOD.

Ben
Director, Commercial Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Samir Desai <samir.desai@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up and procurement path questions after demo

Thanks, Irene and Ben — this is helpful. Two quick updates from our side:

1) Our SOW owner is Samir Desai (cc'd). He can provide the SOW language by EOD 3/4.
2) Finance prefers PO for the production rollout. For the initial pilot, they are willing to approve a card charge if we keep it under $5k and sign a pilot acceptance addendum.

Samir, please let us know if there's any non-standard language Redwood requires in the SOW.

Would appreciate a 15-minute MAP walkthrough on Thu 3/4 at 11:00am PT if that works for Redwood.

Best,
Lydia
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Lydia / Samir — thanks for the updates. Confirming our availability for Thu 3/4 at 11:00am PT for a 15-minute MAP walk-through. I'll bring the legal checklist and a short SOW template that covers scope, data handling, and acceptance criteria.

Quick notes so we align the call:
- Please have your SOW owner (Samir) share the target SOW lines (bullet points) prior to the call so we can mark expected exceptions.
- Ben will upload the SOC2 stub and architecture slide by 3/3 EOD as noted.
- If Acme opts into AWS Marketplace, we will surface the different invoicing cadence on the call.

See you Thu — calendar invite to follow.

Thanks,
